title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Building a One-Stop Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism and One-Stop Litigation Service Center
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Building a One-Stop Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism and a One-Stop Litigation Service Center

Fa Fa [2019] No. 19

In order to deepen the comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial system, comprehensively build a modern litigation service system, and further enhance the ability and level of the people's courts to resolve disputes and serve the people, the following opinions are hereby put forward regarding the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism and a one-stop litigation service center.

I. General Requirements

1. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's new ideas, new thoughts, and new strategies on comprehensively governing the country according to law, uphold the Party's absolute leadership over the work of the people's courts, adhere to justice for the people and fair justice, comprehensively build a modern litigation service system that is intensive and efficient, diversifies dispute resolution, is convenient and beneficial to the people, is smart and precise, open and interactive, and integrated and shared, promote the renewal of concepts and mechanism reform in dispute resolution and litigation services, realize one-stop diversified dispute resolution and one-stop litigation services, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

2. Adhere to a people-centered approach. Increase efforts in judicial convenience, benefit, and welfare for the people, provide the people with rich and fast dispute resolution channels and one-stop high-quality litigation services, and comprehensively enhance the people's sense of gain, happiness, and security.

3. Adhere to the rule of law as a guarantee. Coordinate resources and forces from all aspects to participate in social governance activities on the track of the rule of law, resolve conflicts and disputes, strengthen the role of the judiciary in guaranteeing diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, and promote the formation of a good legal environment in society where things are done according to law, problems are encountered by law, problems are solved by law, and conflicts are resolved by law.

4. Adhere to a problem-oriented and demand-oriented approach. Focus on prominent conflicts and problems, meet diverse judicial needs, promote the formation of a layered, progressive, combined simple and complex, and seamlessly connected one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism, accelerate the construction of a three-dimensional, intensive, and information-based one-stop litigation service center, and enhance the precision, coordination, and effectiveness of diversified dispute resolution and litigation services.

5. Adhere to reform and innovation. Implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee on the comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial system, strengthen linkage and integration, reshape the litigation structure, enhance procedural effectiveness, and form a new model of dispute resolution and litigation services with Chinese characteristics that conforms to China's national conditions, reflects judicial rules, and leads the trend of the times.

6. By the end of 2020, the one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism of courts nationwide will be basically sound, and the one-stop litigation service center will be fully completed. The online case-filing function will be generally available, and cross-regional case-filing services will be fully implemented. Intermediate and grassroots people's courts will establish a work pattern in which the majority of judges handle a few difficult and complex cases, and a few judges handle the majority of simple cases.

II. Work Measures

7. Actively integrate into the construction of a source governance mechanism led by Party committees and governments. Effectively play the role of the people's courts in participating in, promoting, regulating, and guaranteeing source governance, and promote the extension of work to the prevention and control of disputes at the source. Actively coordinate with Party committees and governments to create a "no litigation" rural community, integrated conflict and dispute resolution center, and administrative dispute mediation center, and support the inclusion of source governance in the local peace construction evaluation system. Strengthen support, guidance, and regulation for non-litigation methods of dispute resolution. Strengthen the function of the people's courts in preventing and resolving conflicts and disputes on the spot, actively integrate into the construction of grassroots dispute resolution networks, and do a good job of connecting with grassroots party organizations, political and legal units, and autonomous organizations. Generally establish litigation service stations and judge liaison points, strengthen circuit services and door-to-door services, provide training and guidance for grassroots autonomous organizations within the jurisdiction to resolve disputes, and reduce conflicts and disputes from the source. Strengthen the role of judicial big data in assessing and predicting the development trend of conflicts and risks, and prevent and resolve major conflicts and risks in advance.

8. Improve the linkage mechanism for diversified dispute resolution before litigation. Jointly with relevant departments, issue documents to promote diversified dispute resolution, strengthen procedural connections with mediation, arbitration, notarization, and administrative reconsideration, and improve the connection mechanism for administrative adjudication relief procedures. Smooth the connection channels with trade unions, Communist Youth League, Women's Federation, Law Society, administrative organs, arbitration institutions, notary institutions, industry associations, industry organizations, chambers of commerce, etc., strengthen data coordination and sharing, and designate special personnel to carry out liaison work. Promote the establishment of a pre-mediation mechanism, and give full play to the role of people's mediation, administrative mediation, lawyer mediation, industry mediation, professional mediation, chamber of commerce mediation, and other pre-litigation dispute resolution. Strengthen the judicial confirmation of mediation agreements, further improve the judicial confirmation procedure, explore the establishment of a judicial confirmation liaison mechanism, and promote the comprehensive connection of judicial confirmation with online platforms such as people's mediation, to achieve quick establishment and processing of judicial confirmation of people's mediation.

9. Build specialized mediation platforms by type and profession. According to the types and characteristics of disputes in the region, establish specialized mediation studios in the litigation service center as needed for marriage and family, road traffic, property disputes, labor disputes, medical disputes, banking and insurance, securities and futures, intellectual property, and overseas-related and foreign-related matters. Support the Federation of Industry and Commerce and chamber of commerce organizations in mediating disputes involving enterprises. Encourage the establishment of mediation studios named after mediators or judges. Promote the establishment of lawyer mediation studios. Improve the roster of specially invited mediators and specially invited mediation organizations, and strengthen the training, guidance, and management of mediators.

10. Improve the integrated connection mechanism of litigation and mediation. Promote the substantial connection of litigation and mediation. Establish a mediation and fast-track adjudication team composed of judges, judge assistants, clerks, and mediators, provide timely mediation guidance, strengthen the overall connection between litigation and mediation, and achieve mediation when possible and judgment when appropriate. For disputes brought to court, explain the advantages and characteristics of various dispute resolution methods, provide intelligent risk assessment services, publicize policies on the reduction and exemption of litigation fees, and guide and encourage parties to choose non-litigation methods to resolve disputes in accordance with the principles of voluntariness and legality. For disputes that can be resolved through administrative adjudication, guide parties to resolve them through administrative adjudication according to law; for those suitable for mediation and with the consent of the parties, conduct pre-filing mediation first. If mediation is successful and a legal document needs to be issued, it shall be handled by the judge of the mediation and fast-track adjudication team according to law; if mediation fails, the mediator shall fix the undisputed facts and assist in confirming the service address. Clarify the time limit for pre-litigation mediation, and standardize the procedures for filing and separating simple and complex cases after mediation fails. Establish a management system for pre-litigation mediation cases, achieving case-by-case registration, full-process record-keeping, and dynamic management, and include the workload of pre-litigation mediation in the assessment and statistics scope.

11. Improve the mechanism of "separation, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and trial". Generally carry out the separation of simple and complex cases in first-instance cases, and explore the separation of simple and complex cases in second-instance cases. Set up procedure separators responsible for the separation of mediation and adjudication, and the separation of simple and complex cases. Improve the standards for the separation of simple and complex cases in civil, commercial, and administrative cases, and determine the scope of simple cases based on elements such as the cause of action, litigation subject, litigation claims, legal relationship, and litigation procedure. Generally apply system algorithms plus manual identification to achieve accurate separation. Equip the litigation service center with fast-track adjudication judges or teams, and comprehensively use supervision procedures, judicial confirmation procedures, small claims procedures, summary procedures, and ordinary procedures to try simple cases quickly and simply. Establish supporting mechanisms for fast-track adjudication and quick trial of simple cases. Promote the simplification of litigation procedures, implement centralized handling of similar cases, establish a model litigation mode, create document templates for similar cases, and fully use intelligent voice, online trials, and other methods to improve trial efficiency. Establish and improve the procedure conversion mechanism, designate a special team to undertake the handling of cases converted from simple to complex, and smooth the case transfer channel.

12. Promote the construction and application of online mediation platforms. Fully carry out online mediation work, accelerate the connection of the trial process management systems or self-built mediation platforms of local courts with the Supreme People's Court's online mediation platform, achieve the aggregation of all dispute resolution resources in the region online, realize the online flow of mediation data, and provide parties with one-stop dispute resolution services such as online consultation and evaluation, mediation, confirmation, separation, and fast-track adjudication and quick trial.

13. Improve three-dimensional litigation service channels. Build a litigation service center integrating "hall, network, hotline, and circuit", provide parties with one-stop litigation services through multiple channels such as the litigation service hall, litigation service network, mobile terminals, 12368 litigation service hotline, and circuit handling, achieving handling in one stop, one network, one number, and one time.

14. Strengthen the standardization and normalization of litigation services. With the goal of "getting it done in one go", comprehensively sort out the list of service items, formulate standardized work procedures and one-time service guides for each item, and make them public to the society, standardize service processes, improve service quality, clarify rights and responsibilities, use standardization to promote the universalization and convenience of litigation services, and promote the realization of non-differential acceptance and same-standard handling of the same litigation service matters.

15. Expand full-scope litigation service functions. Provide parties with litigation services such as litigation guidance, convenience services, litigation assistance, dispute resolution, efficiency improvement, and trial affairs. Set up litigation guidance and counseling areas, equip with guides, post flowcharts for handling litigation matters or QR codes for service guides, and provide model complaints for similar cases. Open special channels for prosecutors, lawyers, people's mediators, notaries, judicial appraisers, volunteers, etc., set up rest and waiting areas for parties, and office and rest places for prosecutors and lawyers, and set up barrier-free passages and facilities for persons with disabilities. Build a publicity and education base for the popularization of law facing society, and create a cultural litigation service center.

16. Deepen the reform of "filing on the spot, self-service filing, online filing, and nearby filing". Strictly implement the requirements of the case-filing registration system reform, and in principle file on the spot for lawsuits that meet the acceptance conditions. Establish a list of filing materials for public disclosure, disclose all materials required for filing according to the cause of action, and promote "completion in one go". Generally promote self-service filing, arrange for special personnel to guide, establish fast processing channels, and reduce waiting time for parties. Fully implement online filing, ensuring that all cases that can be filed online are filed online. For parties who choose online filing, all procedures shall be handled online unless it is truly necessary to submit materials in person. For parties who choose to submit filing applications in person, online filing shall not be mandatory. Generally promote cross-regional filing services, set up special service windows, establish a linkage processing mechanism of accepting applications nearby, keeping jurisdiction unchanged, and transferring data online, to achieve the ability to file nearby, file at multiple points, and file quickly with less running.

17. Improve the intensive litigation service mechanism. Promote the concentration of auxiliary and transactional work such as scanning, binding, and case file transfer into the litigation service center for intensive management. Establish an intensive service mechanism, and fully apply the unified delivery platform of the people's courts. Equip special delivery teams responsible for delivery implementation affairs such as appointment delivery, direct delivery,留置 delivery, postal delivery, entrusted delivery, transfer delivery, acceptance delivery, and public announcement delivery. Innovate the intensive service model for preservation and entrusted appraisal. Set up unified service windows for preservation and entrusted appraisal, improve business standards, promote online preservation, and optimize the preservation linkage mechanism. Strengthen the connection with the judicial appraisal management department, do a good job of connecting with the information system of appraisal institutions, and achieve full supervision of the appraisal work.

18. Strengthen work on litigation-related petitions. Smooth the petition channels, standardize the online petition handling procedures, improve the four-level court linkage video reception mechanism, and promote the substantial resolution of petition demands. Establish a multi-department consultation mechanism under the leadership of Party committees, give full play to the role of third parties such as lawyers in participating in the resolution and representing petitions, strengthen data sharing and business coordination, and form a joint force for petition resolution. Deepen the application of the litigation-related petition information system, achieve interconnection with the enforcement petition system, and record all incoming petition letters and visits one by one, unified management, and full-process record-keeping.

19. Improve the internal and external linkage litigation service coordination mechanism. Open up information channels between the people's court litigation service centers and public security and procuratorial organs, administrative organs, people's organizations, industry associations, enterprise organizations, and neighborhood (village) committees, expand the participation of notarization in judicial auxiliary affairs of the people's courts, and form a joint force in delivery, mediation, appraisal, and enforcement. Establish a litigation service coordination mechanism between local courts, share information resources in submitting applications, receiving and transferring materials, and serving legal documents, and continuously expand the scope of cross-regional litigation services.

20. Improve the socialized service mechanism. Strip out all service work that can be completed with the assistance of third parties from society or outsourced, and carry it out through the purchase of services by socialized and professional teams. Further standardize the types, nature, and content of purchased social services. Improve the mechanism for social forces to participate in litigation services, introduce third parties such as experts and scholars, lawyers, psychologists, notaries, appraisers, volunteers, etc., to provide diversified services to the people. Strengthen the connection with universities, and provide a broad platform for students to participate in judicial practice activities.

21. Promote the construction of smart litigation services. Create a new "smart litigation service" model that relies on information technologies such as big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things, connects the hall, hotline, network, and mobile terminal, and handles all litigation business in one go. Expand online service functions, fully apply the China Mobile Micro Court, open the identity authentication channel for parties, and provide one-stop services such as online guidance, filing, payment and refund, inquiry, consultation, case file review, preservation, trial, and petition. Strengthen the construction of the lawyer service platform, and provide services such as online filing, inquiry, case file review, material submission, contacting judges, evidence exchange, mediation, trial, agent petition, and application for enforcement. Equip the litigation service hall with intelligent equipment such as all-in-one convenience service machines. Improve the intelligent Q&A system of the 12368 litigation service hotline. Promote the integrated construction of the "hall, network, hotline, circuit" service platform, realize the interconnection and automatic association of information resources, and provide parties with litigation services that are consistent in standards and data sources. Deeply mine information resources such as filing, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and petitions, conduct full data analysis, scientifically assess the development trend of various conflicts and disputes and the quality and efficiency of trial and enforcement, and provide references for national governance, social governance, and decision-making by Party committees and governments. Strengthen the construction of the security protection system for litigation service network information, and realize the reliable exchange and safe sharing of internal and external network information.

22. Strengthen the construction and application of the litigation service guidance center information platform. Enhance the big data integration function of the litigation service guidance center information platform. Focus on the five aspects of diversified dispute resolution, registration and filing, "separation, mediation, fast-track adjudication, and trial", trial assistance, and litigation-related petitions, and focus on the four links of building mechanisms, setting rules, building platforms, and promoting applications, to achieve the automatic aggregation and big data management of litigation service information resources of the four-level courts. Integrate scattered and independent litigation service application systems, and uniformly connect them to the information platform. Do a good job of connecting with systems such as trial, enforcement, and petitions, strengthen interconnection with mediation organizations, arbitration institutions, etc., and achieve data sharing such as case information and mediator information. Accelerate the promotion of high people's courts to establish regional information platforms. Establish a quality and efficiency evaluation system to achieve visual display and quantifiable evaluation of litigation services of local courts.

III. Organization and Implementation

23. Adhere to the leadership of the Party. Under the leadership of the Party committee and its political and legal affairs committee, strengthen communication and coordination with relevant departments such as the government, solve difficulties in institutions and personnel, form a stable financial investment mechanism, and provide funding guarantees for the purchase of socialized services. Actively promote relevant legislation and provide strong institutional support.

24. Strengthen organizational guarantees. Implement the responsibility system of the first responsible person. Establish a leading group for the work in the region, do a good job of overall coordination of major matters. Increase the funding guarantee for the upgrading of litigation service places and information construction. Clarify the functional positioning of the case-filing tribunal (litigation service center) as the management institution for litigation service matters, and achieve centralized management. Establish a work pattern in which relevant departments actively support and coordinate. Establish a classified assessment system based on the trial level and post characteristics, and include case handling, case-filing petitions, management coordination, and other transactional work in the assessment scope.

25. Strengthen talent team guarantees. Equip necessary posts of judges and sufficient judge assistants to carry out work such as filing, mediation, and fast-track adjudication. Enrich judicial auxiliary personnel and employed personnel to carry out auxiliary and transactional work such as litigation guidance, consultation and inquiry, and material receipt and transfer. Equip a certain number of judicial police, police auxiliary personnel, and security personnel to be responsible for security and other work. Comprehensively strengthen judicial capacity building, carry out categorized training, and enhance professional levels.

26. Ensure the implementation of goals. According to the goals and tasks of this opinion, local courts should accelerate the formulation of implementation rules for the region, and clarify the timetable, roadmap, and responsibility chain for completion. Higher courts should strengthen the inspection and guidance of lower courts by using the big data management function of the information platform, carrying out supervision and inspection, satisfaction surveys, etc. Praise those who implement well and act actively. Urge those who are lagging behind, passive and slack, or slow in progress to rectify.

27. Strengthen publicity and promotion. Through newspapers and magazines, television and websites, microblogs and WeChat, news clients, and other media, comprehensively publicize typical experiences and practices of diversified dispute resolution and litigation services, promptly respond to social concerns, consciously accept social supervision, widely gather social consensus, and create a good atmosphere.

July 31, 2019
